speaker: Li Zhuowu
argument: Journey to the West appears to be about fetching scriptures and vanquishing demons, but it is really about cultivating the mind. The two words ”Shi E” are the cipher of the whole book — liberation from suffering is the cultivation of the mind. Each of the eighty-one ordeals is the externalization of a demon of the heart.
quote: He who reads Journey to the West without knowing the author's purpose will surely treat it as mere play.

speaker: Hu Shi
argument: Journey to the West is at most a highly entertaining comic novel, without any subtle meaning. There is no need to over-interpret it; the fun itself is the value.
quote: At most a highly entertaining comic novel... without any subtle meaning

speaker: Mao Zedong
argument: Sun Wukong's havoc in Heaven is the battle hymn of the oppressed rising against the ruling class. Tang Sanzang's perseverance, Wukong's defiance of authority, and Bajie's hard struggle — the pilgrimage team is a microcosm of the revolutionary ranks.
quote: Tang Sanzang never gives up · Wukong defies authority · Bajie toils hard · the White Dragon Horse bears all grievances
